settings.heading: Ohh goodie!
settings.subhead: Bite-sized creative ideas inspired by real Aussie kids. Take them, print them, share them. They're yours.

settings.question: Are these really free?
settings.answer: Yes. Every freebie is 100% free to download, print and share. No email, no account, no catch.

settings.question: Can teachers use these in class?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Print them, pop them on the smartboard, build a lesson around them. They're made to be used.

settings.question: Can I share them on socials?
settings.answer: Please do. Tag theINmag so the kid who inspired it gets a little buzz.
